boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Texas Christian University
boards.description: Ten current, under-21-safe food and snack options on or near TCU with publicly posted late availability.

cards.title: The Shoppe at Wright
cards.subtitle: 3104 Main Drive, on the TCU campus
cards.notes: Use the campus convenience store for a snack or dorm essential when other TCU retail counters have closed; it is listed as open 24/7.
cards.evidence_claim: TCU Dining lists The Shoppe at Wright at 3104 Main Drive and states that it is open daily, 24/7.
cards.access_notes: TCU Dining currently lists this location as open daily, 24/7.

cards.title: Toppers Pizza – Fort Worth TCU
cards.subtitle: 2901 W. Berry Street, beside TCU
cards.notes: Order pizza for pickup or delivery from the Berry Street location; the operator lists this TCU store as open until 3 a.m. daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Toppers lists its Fort Worth–TCU restaurant at 2901 W. Berry Street with hours of 10:30 a.m.–3 a.m. daily.
cards.access_notes: The official location listing currently shows 10:30 a.m.–3 a.m. daily.

cards.title: Fat Shack Fort Worth
cards.subtitle: Near TCU, Fort Worth
cards.notes: Choose pickup or delivery for sandwiches, burgers, sides, or desserts; the location page says it is five minutes from TCU and open late.
cards.short_summary: Late food near campus, with delivery and pickup.
cards.evidence_claim: Fat Shack says its Fort Worth location is five minutes from TCU and is open 4 p.m.–2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and until 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official page currently lists 4 p.m.–2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and an extra hour on Friday and Saturday.

cards.title: Buffalo Bros TCU
cards.subtitle: 3015 South University Drive, beside TCU
cards.notes: Use the South University Drive restaurant for food ordered from its pizza-and-wings menu; confirm any seating details directly before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A University Drive food stop open every night.
cards.evidence_claim: Buffalo Bros lists its TCU location at 3015 South University Drive and posts hours of 11 a.m.–2 a.m., seven days a week.
cards.access_notes: Official location page currently lists 11 a.m.–2 a.m., seven days a week.

cards.entity_name: The Placery at Hyatt Place Fort Worth / TCU
cards.title: The Placery at Hyatt Place Fort Worth / TCU
cards.subtitle: 3029 Sandage Avenue, near TCU
cards.notes: Use the hotel lobby food counter for a late meal or takeout; choose the food menu and verify service availability when arriving.
cards.evidence_claim: Hyatt lists The Placery at Hyatt Place Fort Worth / TCU, 3029 Sandage Avenue, with hours of 6 a.m.–midnight daily.
cards.source_title: Dining at Hyatt Place Fort Worth / TCU
cards.access_notes: Hyatt currently posts The Placery hours as 6 a.m.–12 a.m. Monday–Sunday.

cards.title: Taco Bell – W. Berry Street
cards.subtitle: 1913 W. Berry Street, Fort Worth
cards.notes: Use the drive-through for a late food pickup; the official location page distinguishes its later drive-through hours from its dine-in hours.
cards.short_summary: Berry Street drive-through open to 4 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists the 1913 W. Berry Street location's drive-through as open 9 a.m.–4 a.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: The official page currently posts drive-through hours until 4 a.m. daily; dine-in closes earlier.

cards.entity_name: Jack in the Box – 2851 W. Berry Street
cards.title: Jack in the Box – W. Berry Street
cards.subtitle: 2851 W. Berry Street, beside TCU
cards.notes: Use the drive-through for a late pickup, since its listed late hours extend beyond the lobby hours; check the day-specific schedule first.
cards.short_summary: A Berry Street drive-through with late service.
cards.evidence_claim: Jack in the Box lists the 2851 W. Berry Street drive-through as operating as late as 3:30 or 4 a.m., depending on the day.
cards.source_title: Jack in the Box – 2851 W. Berry Street
cards.access_notes: Official location page currently lists drive-through closing times of 2–4 a.m.; lobby hours end at 8 p.m.

cards.title: IHOP – S. University Drive
cards.subtitle: 1664 S. University Drive, Fort Worth
cards.notes: Plan a sit-down or takeout meal at the University Drive location; its official listing includes late-night food and states that it is open 24 hours.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP lists its S. University Drive restaurant at 1664 S. University Drive as open 24 hours and offering late-night food.
cards.source_title: IHOP Restaurants in Fort Worth, Texas
cards.access_notes: IHOP's official Fort Worth directory currently marks the 1664 S. University Drive location as open 24 hours.

cards.entity_name: Zalat Pizza – Ft. Worth Foch Street
cards.title: Zalat Pizza – Foch Street
cards.subtitle: 843 Foch Street, Fort Worth
cards.notes: Arrange pickup or delivery from the Foch Street location when its posted schedule fits; this is a farther off-campus option, so plan transport.
cards.short_summary: A late pizza option in the nearby cultural district.
cards.evidence_claim: Zalat lists its Ft. Worth location at 843 Foch Street with closing times of midnight, 2 a.m., or 4 a.m. depending on the day.
cards.source_title: Zalat Pizza – Ft. Worth Foch Street
cards.access_notes: Official location page currently posts midnight Monday–Wednesday, 2 a.m. Thursday, and 4 a.m. Friday–Saturday closing times.

cards.title: Velvet Taco – Fort Worth
cards.subtitle: 2700 W. 7th Street, Fort Worth
cards.notes: Use the West 7th Street location for a later food pickup when its posted schedule applies; this is off campus, so plan transportation.
cards.short_summary: A West 7th food stop with late weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Velvet Taco lists its Fort Worth location at 2700 W. 7th Street as open until midnight Sunday–Wednesday, 1 a.m. Thursday, and 3:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official location page currently posts hours through 12 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday, 1 a.m. Thursday, and 3:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
